subject: MAP: Integration build plan — SDK, streaming, tool-calling (draft)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@acme.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan — SDK, streaming, tool-calling (draft)

Hi Sofia and team,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on product fit and the primary integration milestones. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-v1.2.pdf) focused on the integration build plan we discussed: SDK integration, streaming/real-time, tool-calling endpoints, and structured outputs for downstream workflows. I also attached a lightweight schedule (integration-schedule.xlsx) with suggested owners and durations.

Summary / post-call recap:
- Goal: Production-ready integration supporting streaming responses and tool-calling with structured JSON outputs for the Claims workflow.
- Target close date (contract + initial integration delivery): 2026-09-30 (proposed).

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) SDK Integration (Auth, client libs, example app) — Owner: Redwood (Aditya) — 2 weeks
2) Streaming & Real-time client support (chunked responses + reconnect) — Owner: Redwood (David) — 3 weeks
3) Tool calling endpoints & sandbox wiring (external tool proxies, auth) — Owner: Acme + Redwood (Sofia / Monica) — 2 weeks
4) Structured output contract (JSON schema + validation) — Owner: Acme product + Redwood API (Marissa / Aditya) — 1 week
5) QA, perf testing, and rollout plan — Owner: Redwood CS + Acme QA (Monica / Carlos) — 1.5 weeks

Dependencies:
- Acme provides sandbox API keys and a representative dataset for the Claims flow (sample payloads).
- Access to Acme dev environment and a test account for end-to-end verification.
- Doc-level agreement on the structured output JSON schema.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Please confirm owners for Acme-side responsibilities (sandbox keys, product reviewer, QA point of contact).
- If the proposed schedule or target close date looks off, propose adjustments — we can prioritize SDK + streaming as a first drop.

Sofia — any blockers from procurement/security we should be aware of?

I’ll update the MAP to v1.3 with confirmed owners once we have your replies.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v1.2.pdf (draft), integration-schedule.xlsx (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@acme.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan — SDK, streaming, tool-calling (draft)

Thanks Marissa — nice summary. Some technical clarifications and proposed owners/ETA from our side: 

Quick notes (quoting your milestones):
1) SDK Integration — Owner: Aditya (me)
   - Deliverables: language SDK (JS + Python), auth flow examples (API key + OAuth), simple sample app that shows embed->call->persist.
   - Estimated effort: 8 dev days (incl. example app)

2) Streaming & Real-time client support — Owner: David Kim
   - Deliverables: SSE/websocket-based streaming client examples, reconnect semantics, token/cost guidance for chunked responses.
   - Perf note: we’ll add continuous-batching knobs on the runtime; need expected median sequence lengths and P50 latency SLO from Acme.

3) Tool calling endpoints & sandbox wiring — Joint owner: Acme (Sofia/Carlos) + Redwood (Monica)
   - We’ll surface a local tool-proxy pattern for secure connections. Monica will own the QA harness + integration smoke tests.

4) Structured outputs — Owner: Aditya + Acme product
   - We should lock a small JSON schema for Claims output (max 20 fields) and include schema validation in SDK.

Dependencies / blockers:
- Need sandbox API keys and a sample dataset. Without that, streaming perf validation will be limited.
- If Acme needs on-prem private deployment for data residency, that affects timeline. Please confirm.

If Acme wants to accelerate streaming to a ~2-week timeline, we might re-allocate engineer time but will need their sandbox ASAP.

I’ll update the integration-schedule.xlsx with owner names and effort estimates after we get owner confirmation.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Lead SDK Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Redwood team — appreciate the clear plan. Acme is excited to move forward.

Confirming owners on our side:
- Product reviewer / schema sign-off: Sofia Lopez (me)
- Integration lead (ops/IT): Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acme.com>
- QA point of contact: it-team@acme.com

We can provide sandbox API keys and a representative dataset by end of this week if that helps. Two asks from our side: 
1) Can streaming be accelerated to a 2-week turnaround? That would allow us to start internal E2E testing sooner.
2) We’ll need a short security questionnaire answered (SOC2 evidence) before we start running tests in our sandbox. Monica / Redwood, can you share the typical SOC2 summary?

If you can accelerate streaming, we’d like to target an earlier initial integration drop and move the overall MAP target close to 2026-09-15. Let us know trade-offs.

Thanks,
Sofia Lopez
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp
s.lopez@acme.com

Perfect — thanks Sofia and Carlos (and team) for the quick replies and owner confirmations.

Updated plan / immediate next steps (I’ll publish MAP-v1.3 by end of day):
- SDK Integration: Aditya (Redwood) — 8 dev days — start: 2026-08-18
- Streaming (accelerated): David (Redwood) — 10 dev days (we’ll prioritize and reassign) — target first drop: 2026-08-31
- Tool calling & sandbox wiring: Joint — Acme (Carlos) + Monica (Redwood) — need sandbox keys by 2026-08-20
- Structured outputs schema: Sofia + Aditya — draft by 2026-08-24
- QA & perf testing: Monica + it-team@acme.com — test window 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-07

New proposed target close date: 2026-09-15 (per Acme request). We’ll surface trade-offs in the MAP doc if any timeline compression impacts scope.

Action items: 
- Acme: share sandbox keys + sample dataset by 2026-08-20 (Carlos / it-team)
- Sofia: confirm product reviewer availability for schema sign-off (target 8/24)
- Redwood: publish MAP-v1.3 (Marissa) and updated schedule (Aditya to update sheet)

SOCs/security: Monica — can you attach the SOC2 summary and a short security FAQ in the MAP-v1.3? Sofia requested it for procurement.

I’ll post the updated MAP to the shared drive and link it in this thread. Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Best,
